title: Pianist Bob Laine and Nick's in the Village
summary: He worked a long time with Swedish pianist Bob Laine at Nick's in Greenwich Village.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Bob Laine. Do you know Bob Laine?
A piano player. He was back east a long time.
Yeah, that sounds familiar, but I'm trying to remember.
He played down in the village.
Swedish, yeah. Him and I worked together for quite a long time, at Nick's in the Village. Is that still there?
Nicks? I think Nick's is not there, but there's a place right nearby there.
The same -- you know there's still a lot of clubs and everything.
Uh-huh. I imagine Nick has passed now, because he had a lot of things going down there.
Yes, that was A very active club.
